lines: Follow this page to get timely alerts on
Stipend for research and stay, insurance, air travel (a round-trip air ticket to/from Tokyo) and lump sum on arrival

invites application from Ph.D. degree holders whose age should be 49 years or below. The objective of this program is to promote a deeper understanding of Japan. The selected applicants will receive a stipend for research and stay, insurance, air travel (a round-trip air ticket to/from Tokyo) and a lump sum on arrival.
Applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree or be recognized by MIF as possessing equivalent academic qualifications
Must be 49 years old or less
Applicants must have sufficient conversational ability in English or Japanese
Applicants should not have been in Japan in the past or in the present
Applicants should have firm positions and professions in their home countries and should return to their countries on completion of their fellowship stay by MIF
Applicants must be of sound health and not physically handicapped in any way, which would not prevent from carrying out research in Japan
The application can be done by email with the following steps:
A reprint of what the applicant considers to be his/her the most important publication
A letter of recommendation from the applicant's employer testifying to academic ability and achievements, and confirming the availability of study leave covering the grant period

Certified copies of the applicant's academic certificates (degrees of Ph.D., Master, Bachelor) issued by the university concerned. (These documents should be in English. If the certificate(s) is unavailable in English, please attach the translation in English)

An invitation letter with signature by the scientist of host institution confirming; the period of stay, the research project, the availability of research facilities/materials, and the arrangement of lodging accommodation, under MIF Fellowship Program
Number of fellowships: 20 persons each year
4-14-46, Kamiogi, Suginami-ku, Tokyo, 167-0043 Japan, Email: contact@mif-japan.org
